label: Stable depeg to 0.98 (outside the band - unsnapped)
description: Every configured Debt Manager stable is marked 2 percent below par. 980000 sits outside the snap band, so PriceProviderV2 returns the market value and stable collateral re-prices. This is the step half of the snap-band pair.
path_assumption: instantaneous mark at the shocked level; single-step, no path, no cascade feedback, no partial closes

propagation.note: PriceProviderV2 isStableToken: the shocked market value passes through _getStablePrice, which pins it to exactly 1e6 STRICTLY INSIDE the open interval (990000, 1010000)

accountant lens COMPOSED over a USDC base (baseAsset=USDC, isStableToken=FALSE on liquidUSD itself, TRUE on the base). PriceProviderV2.price() snaps the BASE before multiplying (PriceProviderV2.sol:268-271), so liquidUSD = rate x snap(USDC/USD): its effective factor is snap(1e6 x f)/1e6, NOT f. An in-band base shock holds liquidUSD exactly; only a shock that leaves the open band reaches it. Its own output is never snapped (a config with a baseAsset may not be isStableToken - PriceProviderV2.sol:354). base_asset restates the base named by responds_to, verified at the accept-r4 OP pin

out_of_model: oracle lag and heartbeat behaviour during the move: the shock is applied as an instantaneous mark, while the real feeds update on deviation or heartbeat
deviation-trigger discreteness (a feed moves in rounds, not continuously)
liquidator liquidity, gas costs, execution latency and cascade dynamics
market correlations not mechanically implied by the read paths recorded in recon/derivation-notes.md
intra-sample price wicks: prices are 60-second point samples and an intra-interval spike is invisible by construction (D-012)
the Debt Manager's debt leg is USD-NORMALIZED, so a stable depeg re-prices stable COLLATERAL but not outstanding debt - the asymmetry is the point of this scenario
the Aave-side stables sit behind cap adapters (min(feed, cap)) with no snap; the Aave book is residual dust (about 2.8k USD of debt at the probe pin) so they are excluded here
recovery dynamics: a stable that re-pegs snaps back discontinuously, and this single-step scenario models neither direction's path

per-asset base_asset claims are the DEPLOYED composition graph read from PriceProviderV2.tokenConfig(token).baseAsset at the accept-r4 OP pin (block 154938071, hash 0xaf91dd4ba1975fc3b93e411586ce267892406ed8cb7152c5cefe1c368696c6bc, provider 0x44dd2372FE7B97C4B4D6a7d4DeCf72466485BAcB) - a hash-pinned SAMPLE with no continuity claim (chain-truth R3.1), fixture-welded in internal/risk/testdata/tokenconfig_accept_r4.json; the liquidUSD->USDC and eUSD->none bases ARE verified against that pinned read
liquidUSD is 27.1 percent of book collateral and is COMPOSED over a snapped USDC base, so it moves by snap(1e6 x f)/1e6 rather than by f; the lens rate itself is held flat

eUSD is verified baseAsset=0 (a direct USD accountant lens, not composed over a stable) and is therefore correctly HELD FLAT by this scenario; it appears in the held-flat disclosure rather than the propagation matrix
